name: Report with evidence mapping
steps: Produce the final report mapping each finding to the artifact name, path, and exhibit number.
Include the acquisition summary: tool, version, hash, and a copy of the CoC log.
Include the timeline of events and any artifacts that contradict or corroborate the timeline.
State limitations explicitly (encrypted volumes, logs unavailable, tool version constraints).
Have a second analyst (or supervisor) peer-review the report before release.
tools: Report templates, timeline tools, case file
notes: A finding without an exhibit reference is a rumor, not evidence.
